cohort: The cohort consists of 16,875 adults and 23,206 women in Peru, including both Afro-descendant and non-Afro-descendant individuals, drawn from the Demographic and Family Health Survey 2022.
finding: Afro-descendant individuals in Peru exhibited worse living conditions and specific health, nutrition, and well-being indicators, including higher rates of stunting and adolescent maternity and lower rates of higher education, access to water/sanitation, and various maternal health services, compared to non-Afro-descendants.
mod_finding: Afro-descendant women had a lower proportion of cesarean sections (-9.5 percentage points) and institutional deliveries (-6.3 percentage points) compared to non-Afro-descendant women.
